description: The one shape table: node kind -> {glyph2d, primitive3d, size_mult, label_anchor}. renderers/svg.mjs draws glyph2d, renderers/three.mjs instances primitive3d, lib/layout/metrics.mjs multiplies the glyph radius by size_mult and places the label at label_anchor, so the layout, the clearance gate and both renderers agree on one geometry. An x-<custom> kind needs its own row here (DF_IR_KIND_UNKNOWN in the topology gate, DF_RENDER_SHAPE_UNKNOWN in the render gate).

status.accepted: the glyph filled with var(--df-<color_token>) in 2D; a solid InstancedMesh per primitive in 3D
status.proposal: the same glyph with stroke-dasharray var(--df-proposal-dash) and a translucent fill in 2D; a wireframe twin InstancedMesh per primitive in 3D (one mesh pair per primitive: solid and proposal)

foreign: a node owned by another person (kind boundary, or provenance.owner_person_id other than the viewer's center owner) keeps its glyph and gains the var(--df-foreign) outline ring in 2D and a foreign-coloured halo in 3D
size_mult_note: 1 for every shipped kind: test/fixtures/layout-{500,2000}.json pin positions computed from glyphRadius(node) * size_mult, so a change here means regenerating those fixtures in the same commit (DOTFIELD_WRITE_LAYOUT_FIXTURES=1 node --test test/layout.test.js).
